cv.summary: Network and Systems Engineer | BGP, IPv6, and Linux Infrastructure
cv.intro: Network and systems engineer with a security focus: firewall and network administration, firmware validation, and production troubleshooting. Founder of Saddle Networks, operating AS33711. Linux user since 2013, Hurricane Electric IPv6 Sage, and I build software in Python, Bash, Rust, Go, and Node.js.

points: Design and maintain infrastructure spanning networking, virtualization, and transit provisioning.
Operate the company's BGP autonomous system, AS33711 (128.254.224.0/22, 2602:fbec::/32).
Build internal automation in Python and Bash; enforce security policy across client systems.
Final escalation tier for vulnerability investigation, firmware validation, and regression testing on OpenWRT-based CPE.
Reproduced production-critical defects hands-on to find root cause.
Built and ran TestRail test plans central to the release process; tracked remediation in Jira.
Administered Fortigate firewalls, Aruba wireless, and Meraki environments.
Applied security configurations and coordinated incident response.

building.what: A modern IRRd (Internet Routing Registry daemon) replacement
Apps published on the App Store and Google Play
